context: Two friends chat at the cafe
purpose: Teach: トースト/キャンドル/めんどくさい/しわ/拾う/ガラガラ/バンバン/ローマ字

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの、本気で、絶対、トースト、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、食べたいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm seriously dying to try that new toast you've got.
lines.style: Warm, eager opening. Leans forward slightly. Quick pace to match her enthusiasm. Genuine hunger in the voice, not performed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お店の、本気で、絶対、キャンドル、絶対、夜のお席に、絶対、置いてるよ、メイちゃん、葵で
lines.en: Yeah. We've got it paired with candlelight at the evening tables—it's really something.
lines.style: Soft, proud of the detail. Slightly dreamy quality, imagining the scene. Gentle pacing. She's noticing Mei's excitement and matching it warmly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 掃除、本気で、絶対、めんどくさい、絶対、時、絶対、あるわよね、葵、メイちゃん
lines.en: But keeping the place that beautiful must be exhausting sometimes, doesn't it?
lines.style: Affectionate teasing underneath. Knowing, conspiratorial. Acknowledges the unseen work. Light and caring, not condescending.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: シャツの、本気で、絶対、しわ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、アイロン、絶対、当ててくれる?葵で
lines.en: Actually—would you mind ironing out a few wrinkles in my work shirt for me sometime?
lines.style: Hesitant, almost shy in asking. Looks down slightly. Testing the waters of asking for help. Quiet, not demanding. There's a gentleness in the request.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お客様の落とし物、本気で、絶対、拾うこと、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、心がけてるわ、葵
lines.en: Of course. And I've noticed you always make sure to look after any customers' things they leave behind.
lines.style: Tender recognition. Slow, deliberate pace. She's watching Aoi with genuine affection. Acknowledging something Aoi probably doesn't know she does.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お店、本気で、絶対、開店時、絶対、ガラガラ、絶対、だったよね、メイちゃん、葵で
lines.en: The shop was so quiet when we first opened, remember?
lines.style: Wistful, looking back at a memory. Gentle, almost nostalgic. Slight pause before speaking, as if retrieving the feeling. Soft exhale on the quieter words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しい看板、本気で、絶対、バンバン、絶対、宣伝してるね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: But that new sign you put up—you're really getting the word out there now. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Admiration warming the tone. Bright, genuine praise. Picks up pace slightly on the observation. Pride in her voice for Aoi's initiative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 外国のお客様、本気で、絶対、ローマ字、絶対、案内、絶対、葵で、絶対、用意したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And I prepared Romaji guides for foreign customers so they'd feel welcome from the moment they walk in.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the voice. Modest but present. She's sharing something she's done without fanfare. Steady, thoughtful pace. Pride woven underneath.
